human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact correctly pauses evaluation, rejects the vague bar, resolves judgment versus conformance mode, and prevents runner calls before clarification. It fails O2 because it never says to surface and clarify the target skill's first principles with the user.

observations.value: Stop and ask the user to define a real per-case judgment bar: the outcome to achieve and concrete failure smells. “Make it good” is too vague, and the exact template should not become the bar unless the skill is explicitly conformance-style. Clarify whether it is judgment- or conformance-oriented, then echo the agreed bar before running any agents.
